explanation: Tokyo, meaning eastern capital, replaced the name Edo in 1868. Oslo had been called Christiania, after King Christian IV of Denmark and Norway, since 1624, and took back its medieval name in 1925.

claims.text: The city was named Christiania after King Christian IV of Denmark and Norway in 1624.
Oslo was the city's medieval name.
